description: Defines the TopPosition struct representing the top position in a shape, including constructors, property accessors, and implicit conversions.

classes.name: TopPosition
classes.description: Represents the top position in a shape, with properties for shape position and unit position, and methods for setting and parsing values.

methods.name: SetFromEnum
methods.description: Sets the shape position enum and resets the position.

methods.name: SetFromUnit
methods.description: Sets the position from a Unit object.

methods.name: INullableValue.SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value of TopPosition from an object, handling different types.

methods.name: INullableValue.GetValue
methods.description: Gets the position as either Unit or ShapePosition.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string to create a TopPosition, interpreting as Unit or ShapePosition.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TopPosition into DDL format.
